system.description:
The circle of Myrah Arianel, Protector of the Myllnoris Woods, which keeps the old forests around the elven city and has deep ties to its High Elven Council.

  • Fey Warding: Advantage on saves against charm, enchantment and fey magic while in natural terrain.
    • 9th level: in natural terrain, allies within 10ft of you share it.
  • Warden's Kin: Advantage on checks to speak with or identify creatures of the deep forest, and Myllnoris's woodland wardens know you as an ally on sight.
